facts.detail: The all-premises postcode family contains 121 r2 CSV files, one per postcode area.
The official data note documents 1,741,096 rows for that family.

guard_streams.write_limit: Documented structure is an acceptance target, not archive-byte proof.

facts.detail: The postcode field contains the postcode with spaces removed, for example SE19HA.
The postcode_space field contains the postcode with a single space, for example SE1 9HA.

guard_streams.write_limit: Join normalisation may remove whitespace but must retain exact postcode identity.

facts.detail: The postcode-area field identifies the area, for example SE.
The canonical join resolves target postcodes through the matching r2 postcode-area member.

guard_streams.write_limit: Area membership alone is not a parcel match.

facts.detail: SFBB availability is the percentage of premises with coverage at 30 Mbit/s or greater.
The join maps the official SFBB percentage header to superfast_30mbps_available_pct.

guard_streams.write_limit: Availability percentage is not a measured connection speed.

facts.detail: UFBB 100 availability is the percentage of premises with coverage at 100 Mbit/s or greater.
The join maps the official UFBB 100 percentage header to ultrafast_100mbps_available_pct.

guard_streams.write_limit: Coverage availability cannot be written as parcel-measured throughput.

facts.detail: UFBB availability is the percentage of premises with coverage at 300 Mbit/s or greater.
The join maps the official UFBB percentage header to ultrafast_300mbps_available_pct.

guard_streams.write_limit: The 300 Mbit/s threshold is an availability class, not an observed speed.

facts.detail: Gigabit availability is the percentage of premises covered by a gigabit-capable service.
Ofcom reports gigabit-capable coverage at postcode level.

guard_streams.write_limit: Exact postcode evidence is still required before candidate promotion.

facts.detail: Full-fibre availability is provided for local authority and constituency levels.
Ofcom does not publish postcode or output-area full-fibre coverage because of commercial confidentiality.

guard_streams.write_limit: No postcode or parcel full-fibre value may be inferred.

facts.detail: Unable-to-receive percentages are defined for thresholds X equal to 2, 5, 10 or 30 Mbit/s.
These fields describe matched premises without access above the selected threshold.

guard_streams.write_limit: Matched-premises percentages must not be treated as all-premises counts.

facts.detail: Decent broadband requires at least 10 Mbit/s download and 1 Mbit/s upload.
The unable-from-fixed-or-FWA measure includes non-matched records and zero predicted speeds.

guard_streams.write_limit: This composite coverage measure is not a parcel speed test.

facts.detail: All coverage figures refer to fixed-line broadband unless FWA is explicitly named in the field description.
The FWA decent-broadband field describes access at the 10/1 threshold from a wireless internet service provider.

guard_streams.write_limit: Fixed-line and FWA semantics must remain separated by field definition.

facts.detail: Maximum-download availability bands are 0-2, 2-5, 5-10, 10-30 and 30-300 Mbit/s.
A separate field reports premises with maximum available download speed of at least 300 Mbit/s.

guard_streams.write_limit: Band availability is categorical coverage evidence, not measured parcel performance.
